Founded in 1991, the vineyard was taken over in 2000 by Véronique Hupin and Michael Marler. In Farnham, they farm a little over four hectares of vines and have helped make biodynamics an important reference in Quebec's wine landscape. Their approach favors hand harvesting, spontaneous fermentations and patient ageing, with very little cellar intervention.

name: Les Pervenches
oneLiner: À Farnham, Les Pervenches cultivent un peu plus de quatre hectares en bio et biodynamie et signent des vins précis, vivants et profondément liés à leurs parcelles.
oneLinerEn: In Farnham, Les Pervenches farm just over four hectares organically and biodynamically, crafting precise, lively wines deeply connected to their parcels.
visitDetails: Le vignoble n’est actuellement pas ouvert au public pour les visites ou les dégustations.
visitDetailsEn: The vineyard is currently not open to the public for visits or tastings.
whyWeFollow: Parce que Les Pervenches font partie des domaines qui permettent de comprendre le changement de niveau du vin québécois : travail parcellaire, viticulture exigeante, vinifications précises et identité forte sans chercher à imiter ailleurs.
whyWeFollowEn: Because Les Pervenches are among the domaines that help explain how Quebec wine has moved up a level: parcel-by-parcel work, exacting viticulture, precise winemaking and a strong identity that doesn't try to imitate elsewhere.
